title: Replace the 'accepts any exception' navigation assertion in hierarchy_navigation_test.dart and curriculum_list_screen_test.dart with real router verification
rule: TQ-8 (assertion weaker than what the source can do wrong)
why: Both tests tap a curriculum row and assert only that `tester.takeException()` is non-null — that passes for any exception at all, including an unrelated build error introduced by a future regression, not specifically the intended 'no AutoRouter in the test tree' push failure. hierarchy_navigation_test.dart also pre-builds elaborate filterByLevel mocks for three deeper drill levels (Berachos, Perek 1, Mishna 1) that are never exercised because the test ends at the very first tap — dead setup code that makes the test look far more thorough than it is. This same batch already contains the fix pattern in text_display_screen_l1_test.dart and r2_content_hierarchy_nav_test.dart: inject a mocktail `_MockStackRouter` via `StackRouterScope` and `verify()` the specific push/replace call.
recommendation: Swap the AutoRouter-less MaterialApp harness for the StackRouterScope + _MockStackRouter pattern already used elsewhere in this batch, and verify() the specific route pushed. Delete or actually use the now-provably-dead multi-level filterByLevel mock setup in hierarchy_navigation_test.dart's first test.
acceptance_criteria: Both tests assert a specific route via verify(() => router.push(any(that: isA<ContentHierarchyRoute>()))) or equivalent, not `exception, isNotNull`.
